from.place: Affine case: invariance of O(C)^×/O(C)^{×n} under k ⊂ k'

title: Units modulo powers are invariant under algebraically closed base change
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $C$ be a smooth affine connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $n\geq1$. Then pullback induces an isomorphism $\mathcal O_C(C)^\times/\mathcal O_C(C)^\times{}^{\,n} \xrightarrow{\sim} \mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times/\mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times{}^{\,n}$.

proof.text: Choose a smooth proper connected compactification $j:C\hookrightarrow\overline C$ with finite boundary $S$ by [lem-sc-compactification]. By [lem-sc-base-change-curve], base change gives a smooth proper curve $\overline C'$ and the base-changed open immersion $C'\hookrightarrow\overline C'$; the boundary is $S'=\overline C'\setminus C'$. The identification of the free divisor groups supported on $S$ and $S'$ follows from the definitions and the fibre-product base change in [def-sc-field-extension].

source.place: Affine-case proof, compactification and boundary setup

proof.text: Let $L$ (respectively $L'$) be the subgroup of divisors supported on $S$ (respectively $S'$) which are boundary divisors of units on $C$ (respectively $C_{k'}$). By [lem-sc-affine-unit-divisor-base-change], the identification $\iota$ sends $L$ isomorphically onto $L'$ and is compatible with pullback of units: $\operatorname{div}(\pi^*u)=\iota(\operatorname{div}u)$. The divisor map $\mathcal O_C(C)^\times\to L$ is surjective by definition of $L$, and its kernel is $k^\times$: taking global sections of the exact sequence $0\to\mathbf G_m\to j_*\mathbf G_m\to\bigoplus_{P\in S}i_{P*}\mathbf Z$ of [lem-sc-divisor-exact-sequence] (global sections are left exact) shows that a unit on $C$ with zero boundary divisor is a global unit on $\overline C$, hence in $H^0(\overline C,\mathcal O_{\overline C})^\times=k^\times$ by [lem-sc-global-functions]. The same holds over $k'$ for $C'\subseteq\overline C'$ (a proper smooth connected curve by step 1).

source.place: Affine-case proof, divisor map and constants

proof.text: Every element of $k^\times$ and $k'^\times$ is an $n$-th power because both fields are algebraically closed. Hence the divisor maps identify $\mathcal O_C(C)^\times/\mathcal O_C(C)^\times{}^{\,n}$ and $\mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times/\mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times{}^{\,n}$ with $L/nL$ and $L'/nL'$, respectively: equality of divisor classes modulo $n$ gives a quotient by an $n$-th power up to a constant, and the constant has an $n$-th root. Since $\operatorname{div}(\pi^*u)=\iota(\operatorname{div}u)$ and $\iota(L)=L'$ (step 2), the square formed by pullback, the two divisor maps and $\iota$ commutes, so pullback $\mathcal O_C(C)^\times/n\to\mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times/n$ is identified with the isomorphism $L/nL\cong L'/nL'$ induced by $\iota$.
